recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes

recoveryCodes.saved: I saved these codes in a safe place

account.title: My account

password.title: Change password

password.changed: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.help: Create a new set if you used most of your codes or think someone saw them. The old codes stop working.

code.title: Enter the setup code

language.title: Choose your language

admin.title: Create the administrator account
admin.help: This account can do everything in Alice. It always signs in with a password and a code from an authenticator app.
admin.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
admin.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password twice.

passphrase.title: Choose a recovery passphrase
passphrase.warning: This passphrase protects your backups. If you lose it, backups cannot be opened and nobody, including the vendor, can help.
passphrase.label: Recovery passphrase
passphrase.help: At least 16 characters. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this server.
passphrase.mismatch: The two passphrases are different. Type the same passphrase twice.

strength.tooShort: Too short: use at least 16 characters.

done.title: Alice is ready
done.help: Your administrator account and recovery passphrase are set. Next, add the people who will use Alice on the Users page.

license.title: Add a license
license.help: Send this Installation ID to your vendor to get a license file, then upload it here. You can also start with the 30-day evaluation and add the license later on the License page.
license.evaluateHelp: The evaluation started when Alice was installed. After 30 days, Alice pauses automatic tasks and changes to your servers until a license is uploaded. Your data is kept.

platform.title: Connect your servers
platform.help: Alice signs in to your servers with its own key. Prepare each server with the commands below; you can also do this later on the Servers page.
platform.addedFailed: The server was added, but Alice could not finish the first check. After the setup, open it on the Servers page.

users.title: Users
users.resetPasswordText: The person is signed out everywhere, their API tokens stop working, and they must use this password at the next sign-in. Give it to them in a safe way.

fields.name: Full name
fields.initialPasswordHelp: At least 12 characters. The person sets up their authenticator app at the first sign-in.

confirm.resetMfaText: The person is signed out and must set up their authenticator app again at the next sign-in.
confirm.revokeText: The person is signed out on every device and all their API tokens stop working.
confirm.disableText: The person is signed out, their API tokens stop working, and they cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
confirm.enableText: The person can sign in again with their password and authenticator app.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: API tokens let scripts and other tools use Alice on your behalf. A token never has more rights than your own role.
tokens.createdText: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeText: Scripts that use this token stop working immediately.

actions.certificate_key_attached: Private key added to a certificate
actions.audit_exported_busy: Audit log export refused: another check or export was running

reason.password_reset: New password set by an administrator

problem.seal_missing: The protection of the installation record was removed

banner.evaluation_one: Evaluation mode: {{count}} day left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_other: Evaluation mode: {{count}} days left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_ended: The evaluation period has ended. Alice is now read-only for changes. Administrators can upload a license on the License page.
banner.expiry_warning_one: Your license expires in {{count}} day ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.expiry_warning_other: Your license expires in {{count}} days ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.grace: Your license expired on {{valid_until}}. Alice will stop automatic work on {{locks_at}} (168 hours after expiry). Contact your vendor now. Grace day {{grace_day}} of 7.
banner.locked: License expired. Automatic tasks are paused. Your data is safe and certificate expiry alerts still arrive by email. Administrators: upload a new license on the License page.
banner.tampered: License data was changed outside Alice, so Alice ignores the changed file. Upload the license file from your vendor again.
banner.clock_behind: The server clock changed unexpectedly (it says {{system_time}}, but Alice last saw {{last_seen}}). Alice is using the later date for license checks. Please correct the server time or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_one: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} day. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_other: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} days. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.pending: A new license ({{license_id}}) starts on {{valid_from}}. The current license stays in use until then.
banner.over_limit: You use {{used}} of {{max}} licensed targets. You cannot add more until you are within the limit.
banner.limit_reached: You are using all {{max}} licensed targets. To add more, ask your vendor to increase your license.
banner.unverified: Alice could not check its license since {{last_checked}}. Changes to managed systems are paused until the check succeeds. Tasks requested meanwhile wait and start by themselves after the next successful check.

installation.title: Installation ID
installation.help: Your vendor needs this ID to make a license for this installation. Copy it and email it to your vendor.

current.title: Current license
current.evaluation_one: Evaluation: {{count}} day left, up to {{max}} targets.
current.evaluation_other: Evaluation: {{count}} days left, up to {{max}} targets.
current.tampered: A stored license file was changed outside Alice and is ignored.

upload.title: Upload a license
upload.label: License file
upload.help: The file from your vendor's email, for example alice-license-yourcompany-20261001.alicelic.
upload.previewSummary: Licensed to {{customer}}. Up to {{max}} managed targets. Valid from {{from}} to {{until}}.
upload.alreadyExpired: This license has already expired. It is installed anyway; its own dates decide whether Alice is in the grace period or locked.
upload.pending: This license starts on {{from}}. The current license stays in use until then.
upload.activated: License activated. All features are available again.
upload.installedPending: The license is installed and starts on {{from}}.
upload.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a license.

upload.title: Upload a certificate
upload.help: Upload the certificate with its chain and its private key. Alice checks that they belong together before it stores them. The private key is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
upload.label: Name (optional)
upload.chainWarning: The chain is incomplete. An administrator must confirm before this certificate is deployed.
upload.notYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet. Websites would show an error until its start date.
upload.secretWarning: Paste a private key only into this form, never into a comment or reason field.
upload.chainExpiredWarning: A certificate in the chain has expired. Browsers may refuse this certificate until the chain is replaced.
upload.nameMismatchWarning: The domain names in the certificate differ from the signing request. Check that it is the certificate you ordered.
upload.fileTooLarge: This file is larger than 256 KiB.
upload.textTooLarge: This text is longer than 256 KiB.
upload.readFailed: Alice could not read this file. Choose it again.
upload.otherWarning: Alice stored the certificate and noted a condition that this version cannot describe.
upload.networkUnknown: The connection was lost. The upload may or may not have reached Alice. Check the certificate list before you try again.
upload.chainCompleted: Alice already had this certificate. Its chain is now complete.

csr.title: Create a signing request
csr.help: Alice creates a new private key and a signing request (CSR). Send the request to your certificate authority, then add the certificate it returns here. The private key never leaves Alice.
csr.created: Signing request created. Copy it and send it to your certificate authority.
csr.completeHelp: Paste the certificate your certificate authority returned, with its chain. Request: {{name}}
csr.cancelHelp: You can no longer add a certificate for this request.

verify.title: Verification settings
verify.help: After a deployment Alice connects to the website and checks that the new certificate is served. Change these only when Alice cannot reach the website directly, for example behind a load balancer.
verify.port: Port to check (empty: the port from the configuration)
verify.sni: Name to check (empty: from the configuration)
verify.skip: Skip the check for this website
verify.skipHelp: Not recommended: a wrong certificate would not be noticed or restored automatically.
verify.readOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.
verify.portInvalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, or leave the field empty.
verify.sniIp: Enter a domain name, not an IP address.
verify.sniWildcard: Enter one domain name without a wildcard (*).
verify.sniInvalid: Enter a domain name with letters, digits, dots and hyphens only. A part between dots cannot start or end with a hyphen.
verify.notSaved: Your change was not saved because this website changed in the meantime. The current values are shown now. Check them and save again.

deploy.title: Deploy a certificate
deploy.noCandidates: Alice holds no certificate with a private key that fits this website. Upload one first.
deploy.summary: Alice backs up the current files, writes the new certificate and key, checks the Nginx configuration, reloads Nginx and checks that the new certificate is served. If any step fails, Alice restores the previous files.
deploy.confirmChain: I confirm that this incomplete chain is intended
deploy.chainAdminOnly: The chain of this certificate is incomplete. An administrator must deploy it.
deploy.noWebsites: This certificate is not used on any website that Alice can deploy to. Open the server of the website and choose Deploy certificate there.
deploy.notYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet and cannot be deployed.
deploy.limit: You can deploy to at most {{max}} websites at once. Untick some websites.
deploy.refused: Alice stopped here. A request names only the first website that stops it, so other websites may need attention too. Nothing was deployed; fix this website or untick it and try again.
deploy.succeeded: The new certificate is live and verified.
deploy.verifiedLocally: Alice checked it from the server itself because it cannot reach the website directly.
deploy.verifySkipped: The check was skipped for this website, so Alice did not confirm that the new certificate is served.
deploy.unchanged: This certificate was already in place. Nothing was changed.
deploy.rolledBack: Your server was restored to its previous certificate.
deploy.noChange: Nothing was changed on the server.
deploy.rollbackFailed: Alice cannot confirm which certificate the website serves. Manual action is needed.
deploy.recovering: Alice has not yet confirmed how this deployment ended. It is checking the server and will finish or undo the change.
deploy.held: The license has expired, so this deployment is on hold. It continues when an administrator renews the license or runs it.
deploy.jobStopped: The background job ended before the deployment did. Open the deployment history to see where it stands.
deploy.unknownStatus: Alice cannot tell the state of this deployment. Open the deployment history to see it.
deploy.stillWorking: Alice is still working on this. Open the deployment history in a minute to see the result.
deploy.connectionLost: Your browser cannot reach Alice right now. The deployment goes on in the background. Open the deployment history in a minute to see the result.
deploy.succeededUnverified: The new certificate was deployed and Nginx was reloaded.
deploy.rollbackFailedRestored: The previous files are back, but Alice could not confirm that the website serves the previous certificate. Check the website now.
deploy.finishing: The background job has finished. Alice is recording the result.
